t: This was an art gallery founded by William Ohly, who was a British collector of ethnographic art and a gallery owner. His Berkeley Galleries and his Abbey Art Centre and Museum were important features of the London art scene in the middle of the twentieth century. The gallery later passed into the ownership of Ernest Ohly, an art dealer who died in 2008. The material I have is thin on the building itself, so the story here is really about the Ohly name and the part it played in London's mid-century art world.
